text:
maya: Quick sync — RC branch (release/v1.10.0-rc) is green in CI. planning to tag v1.10.0 around 17:00 PT unless any blockers.

maya: Incoming checklist:
- bump package.json @root
- update CHANGELOG.md with PRs (#1426, #1429)
- create annotated & signed tag
- push tag + create Draft GitHub Release with assets

alex: thumbs up. Are we doing annotated tag + gpg signing or a lightweight signed tag? :thinking:

maya: annotated + GPG-signed. We need the signature on the tag so consumers can verify.

jordan: FYI CI already uploaded artifacts to the release bucket: https://ci.redwood-inference/artifacts/1.10.0/ (tar, wheel, checksums).

release-bot: artifact-upload: inference-runtime-linux-x86_64.tar.gz (sha256: 3a5f1b2c...) uploaded by ci-pipeline at 2026-11-17T15:34:00Z

liam: I've updated CHANGELOG for the 2 user-facing items. PR is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1432

sarah: If someone's going to create the draft release, can you also attach the sha256 file and sign that artifact too?

maya: plan:
1) ensure GPG agent loaded on release laptop
2) run: git checkout release/v1.10.0-rc && git merge --no-ff main
3) bump version: npm version 1.10.0 --no-git-tag-version
4) commit changelog + package.json
5) create annotated + signed tag:
   git tag -a v1.10.0 -m "Release v1.10.0" && git tag -s v1.10.0 -v
   or: git tag -s -m "Release v1.10.0" v1.10.0
6) push tag: git push origin v1.10.0

maya: example signing commands for artifacts:
```
sha256sum inference-runtime-linux-x86_64.tar.gz > inference-runtime-linux-x86_64.tar.gz.sha256
gpg --armor --detach-sign inference-runtime-linux-x86_64.tar.gz.sha256
```

alex: For GitHub draft creation, I recommend gh CLI:
```
gh release create v1.10.0 --draft --notes-file RELEASE_NOTES.md
gh release upload v1.10.0 inference-runtime-linux-x86_64.tar.gz --clobber
``` 

jordan: note: gh release create will not attach signed tag (that's from git). Make sure to push the signed tag first.

liam: Also, CI produces a checksums manifest already. I'll verify the values before you push.

sarah: cutoff reminder — freeze branches at 16:45 PT to give 15min for last CI runs and sign-off. If anyone needs a hotfix after cutoff, we do a post-release patch.

maya: @alex @jordan can one of you take tag/sign push and create the draft at ~17:00 PT? I'll be on call to verify notes and attach signed checksums.

alex: I can take it. Will ping here when done.

release-bot: deploy-check: release notes draft created in staging by ci-release-runner at 2026-11-17T16:58:10Z

alex: done — pushed signed tag v1.10.0 and created draft release (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.10.0). Uploaded artifacts + .sha256.asc

maya: verified signatures and checksums, everything matches. moving to final publish in ~30m unless objections.

jordan: no objections from infra side. :+1:

liam: thumbs up from docs.

sarah: good to go from security.

maya: publishing now. will post update once live.

alex: published. release is live and release notes are in the draft -> published state.

maya: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the release post and update the internal release tracker.
